description:
Suite’s Story:

Suite makes it incredibly easy for creative teams to store, share, and edit massive media files—like they’re sitting next to each other, even when they’re not. No more waiting on downloads or messing with sync issues. Just smooth, fast collaboration that keeps projects in flow and artists in the zone.

We’re a small experienced team with a mission to solve the biggest problems facing the media and entertainment industry. We’re not building another SaaS web app, we’re solving difficult and complex problems at the intersection of storage, networking, creative workflows, and AI. As we grow, we’re looking for a Principal Product Manager who can own the product end to end, from the editor’s timeline to the infrastructure underneath it, and help us decide what we build next and why. If this speaks to you, come join us.

Who you are

  • You’ve shipped product that people depend on every day, ideally in media & entertainment, creative tools, or technical infrastructure

  • You are extremely AI fluent. You’ve built and shipped AI-powered features or applications, you understand what LLMs and media models can and can’t do today, and you have strong opinions about where they’re headed

  • You use AI tools as a core part of how you work every day, and you expect the people around you to do the same

  • You take pragmatic approaches to product: small bets, fast feedback, and the discipline to kill what isn’t working

  • You write clearly and often. Your specs, briefs, and customer notes are the ones people actually read

  • You’ve worked closely with XP or lean engineering teams and like being in the room, not handing things over a wall

  • You’ve talked to hundreds of customers and know how to turn what they say into what they need

  • You want to help shape the company, culture, AND product. You don’t want “just another job”

Your day-to-day

  • Leading our day to day AI product direction - constantly iterating on our product and helping our engineering team ship additional value weekly.

  • Spending real time with post-production teams, studios, and creative agencies daily to understand how we need to improve

  • Pairing with engineers on discovery, scoping, and iteration, in the room while things get built

  • Prototyping ideas yourself with AI tools to test them with customers before a line of production code is written

  • Translating customer problems into crisp, prioritized problem statements the team can run with

  • Partnering with sales, marketing, and support to make sure what we ship lands and what we learn comes back

  • Defining and tracking the metrics that provide signals as to how we are doing and where we go next

  • Teaching, learning from, and collaborating with teammates

 

Benefits at Suite:

  • Best in class health & dental

  • Hybrid work environment; A balance of in-office and remote work to foster collaboration and flexibility (for those located in the Denver/Boulder area)

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Fitness & wellness stipend

  • Taco Tuesday, every Tuesday

    Some roles, such as internships, may not be eligible for certain benefits.
